g.text: FanCtrl3 Pro - USB-only 3x 4-pin PWM fan controller

g.desc: FanCtrl3 Pro - USB-only 3x 4-pin PWM fan controller

g.text: Power budget: 3 fans of up to 0.6 W each -> ~0.45 A from USB

g.desc: Power budget: 3 fans of up to 0.6 W each -> ~0.45 A from USB

g.text: PWM 25 kHz open-drain; tach pulled up to 3V3 on fan side, 10k series to GPIO
